messages:
sara (eng-platform): Heads up — private rollout dryrun for customer Helios scheduled TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Quick async: who owns cert rotation + airgap image sync + SD-WAN fallback? Current blockers: registry mirroring not confirmed, KMS/HSM onboarding pending, and an SD-WAN ACL that might drop mirror traffic. Need owners, PR links, and any showstopper notes.
kevin (eng-sre): I can own SD-WAN fallback + NAT rule staging. Will ping netops for the BGP community and ephemeral route. @liam can you confirm whether mirror jobs will use proxy or direct egress?
liam (eng-infra): I'll take registry mirror verification. Mirror job INF-4821 shows last run but we need signed images from release infra. Which signing flow are we expecting — cosign or legacy GPG?
anya (product): Product wants canary traffic shaping (sticky to dedicated pool) and a soft-fail to hosted if local model is unreachable. @sara is that already in the rollout config? :eyes:
sara (eng-platform): Canary config is in the rollout repo (https://git.internal/redwood/rollouts/helios). It includes sticky session rules. Cert rotation owner still needed.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy/helios: smoke checks passed (3/3) — readiness OK. Logs: all probes OK, metrics within thresholds.
maria (eng-platform): I can take cert rotation and the KMS/HSM handshake. Note: customer requires HSM-wrapped keys, so Security needs to approve onboarding (SEC-1123). I'll open the ticket if someone confirms owner mapping.
kevin (eng-sre): Pls add the ops runbook snippet for testing image pull behind airgap. Quick example: 
```
# test pull behind airgap proxy
docker pull private-registry.local/helios/infra:canary
curl -I https://mirror.local/v2/ | grep 200
```
liam (eng-infra): Thanks — I'm re-running the mirror job now. INF-4821 last success: 2026-03-16T18:12:09Z. Kicking a re-sync, will post results in 5m.
maria (eng-platform): Added runbook and rotation checklist in PR #987. Also pushed a tiny helper for signature verification: 
```
./verify_image.sh private-registry.local/helios/infra:canary
# => SIGNATURE OK
```
liam (eng-infra): Mirror job re-run complete: last-sync=2026-03-17T02:45:31Z, missing layers for tag `canary` fixed. I also validated cosign sig present. Ticket INF-4821 updated.
kevin (eng-sre): Netops confirmed temporary egress exception to 172.16.8.0/24 for registry sync window tomorrow 08:30-10:30 PT. Remember to remove rule after.
anya (product): For fallback behavior — what env flag toggles hosted degrade? We want graceful UX and fallback telemetry.
sara (eng-platform): Use REDWOOD_FALLBACK=hosted and routePolicy: failover-hosted in rollout yaml. Also added fallback telemetry hook to the canary dashboard.
maria (eng-platform): Owner mapping for tomorrow: certs/KMS = maria, registry mirror = liam, SD-WAN/NAT = kevin, canary config = sara. I'll be on-call for the 09:00 dryrun. Anyone else want to pair on the first 30m? :wave:
kevin (eng-sre): I'll pair the first 30m for SD-WAN smoke.
liam (eng-infra): I'll join for registry validation, and I can stay for the wrap if needed.
anya (product): I'll be on standby for canary behavior checks.
sara (eng-platform): Great — I'll update the sheet and post the final checklist in this thread + the rollout channel. If anything changes ping me directly.
